Application & Admission
ZGSM is an international graduate school in mathematics. Each year 10-20 doctoral positions for international students are offered on a competitive basis. Mathematicians with the necessary qualifications are welcome to apply within any of the two application periods.
Online application is required.
Information on the admission process can be found under the header 'Admission & Enrollment'.
Deadlines
There are two application periods with deadline April 05 and December 05.
These deadlines are also valid for the recommenders - besides for applications that are submitted within the last two weeks before the deadline. For these applications the recommenders have time to send their letters until April 10 and December 10.
Review
The review process of the applications received in a given application period starts right after the deadline has passed.
